newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1996/97 rice output seen at 21.27 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1996/97 rice output seen at 21.27 mln tonnes.

text.p: Thailand's agriculture ministry on Thursday projected the 1996/97 (April-March) rice output at 21.27 tonnes.
First crop rice was revised up slightly to 17.75 million tonnes from 17.6 tonnes in an earlier forecast. The second crop rice was put at 3.52 million tonnes.
Corn (July-June) output was barely affected by heavy floods last year. On the contrary, production was boosted to 4.39 million tonnes from 4.38 million tonnes seen earlier.
An agriculture ministry official attributed the anticipated rise to new hybrids which were popular among farmers due to their high yield and resistance to floods and disease.
But floods and rain appeared to have taken a toll on soybean production (April-March) and especially coffee (October-November) output.
The agriculture ministry revised the coffee output forecast down to 79,027 tonnes from 81,731 tonnes projected earlier.
Soybean output was put at 352,279 tonnes from 352,600 tonnes earlier, although industry sources argued that the actual output could be lower.
